# Rodrigo Yokota

> Platform Engineer based in Curitiba, PR, Brazil, working across Zephyr Cloud and
> The AI Platform. Builds deployment infrastructure, federated frontend tooling, and
> agent platforms. Writes mostly TypeScript, plus Swift, Python, PHP, and Dart.

- Site: https://yokota.dev
- Contact: rodrigo@yokota.dev
- Location: Curitiba, PR, Brazil (UTC-3)
- Certification: AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner

## Current work

- Platform Engineer at [Zephyr Cloud](https://zephyr-cloud.io) since November 2023, first
  through Valor Software and directly employed since December 2025. Bundler integrations,
  deployment pipelines, and global edge delivery for teams building with Module Federation.
- Platform work on [The AI Platform](https://theaiplatform.app): a multi-agent, multi-human
  workspace covering model routing, reusable specialists, evidence-led review, and
  AI-enabled mini apps.

## Focus areas

- Federated delivery: Module Federation, Rspack, Webpack, Vite.
- Platform engineering: TypeScript, Node.js, AWS, CI/CD.
- Agent platforms: agent tooling, evaluation, desktop clients.

## Open source

- [guaranate](https://github.com/ryok90/guaranate): native Swift/macOS keep-awake CLI built on IOKit.
- [Module Federation](https://github.com/module-federation): contributor.
